items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Well, we played together a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah. You see, Robichaux had to get rid of his bass player, the guitar player, the kind of me, and his saxophone player. He went with, uh, yeah. He went with, uh, uh, he got, uh, Thetto. What's Thetto's name? You know Thetto's name? Thetto Harris. Yeah. He got him, his saxophone player. I suppose you're gonna talk to him. Well, uh, he's, uh, he had a stroke. I don't believe he's playing no more. And you know his brother, huh? Yeah. But, uh, Thetto, I never did play with his band either. We played with all these…
He played with, uh, uh, Dan's Vee.
